newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Sept car registrations up 1.0 pct -industry.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Sept car registrations up 1.0 pct -industry.

text.p: Swedish new car registrations rose by one percent in September to 14,789 cars, industry body AB Bilstatistik said on Tuesday.
It said 127,119 passenger cars had been registered in the first nine months of the year, a four percent increase on the 122,775 registered in the same period last year.
Volvo's 800 series has been the country's most-sold car this year at 15,345, followed by the Volvo 900 series at 8,456 and Volkswagen's Golf at 6,724, Bilstatistik said in a statement.
Official car registration figures were due from Statistics Sweden at 0800 GMT, but technical problems have delayed the figure until 0805 GMT on Wednesday.
